property_summary: For every non-empty _tos array, C.transfer(...) always returns true when the call completes; the mutant returns false for some inputs, violating this invariant.

For any non-empty _tos array where all external calls to caddress succeed (do not revert), C.transfer(...) returns true; the mutant returns false for such inputs, so the property is that successful transfers return true — the bug breaks this by returning false.
For any non-empty _tos array and a callee address that does not revert when called, C.transfer(...) returns true; the mutant returns false for those inputs, violating this rule.

For any non-empty _tos array and any callee contract that always reverts on the specified selector, C.transfer(...) reverts (propagates the revert) whereas the mutant still reverts — we instead assert that when all low-level calls to caddress succeed (i.e., the callee returns true for each call selector), C.transfer returns true; the mutant returns false for those same inputs, so the property is that for any non-empty _tos and a callee that always succeeds on the selector, transfer returns true.
For any non-empty _tos array and a callee contract that always returns success for the transferFrom selector, C.transfer(...) returns true (the mutant returns false for such inputs).
